rules.controlName: GenAI / LLM workload — control theme logging
rules.description: Tamper-evident logging for model invocations and governance events; prompts and outputs redacted or hashed per retention policy (architecture review vocabulary only).

rules.controlName: GenAI / LLM workload — control theme encryption
rules.description: Customer-managed or platform keys for model endpoints, vector stores, and prompt caches; TLS for all inference and RAG retrieval paths.

rules.controlName: GenAI / LLM workload — control theme access
rules.description: Entra ID / RBAC for who can deploy models, change system prompts, or access evaluation datasets; break-glass for ops documented.

rules.controlName: GenAI / LLM workload — control theme thirdparty
rules.description: Model provider and embedding API inventory; data-processing terms and egress boundaries before production traffic (no legal attestation implied).

rules.controlName: GenAI / LLM workload — control theme segmentation
rules.description: Separate subnets and identities for inference plane, RAG corpus, and corporate data; deny-by-default east-west between tiers.

rules.controlName: GenAI / LLM workload — control theme dr
rules.description: Fallback routing or degraded mode when the primary model endpoint is unavailable; RPO/RTO expectations stated for copilot surfaces.

rules.controlName: GenAI / LLM workload — control theme changes
rules.description: Versioned prompts, tool schemas, and model SKUs through CI/CD; human review for high-risk capability changes.

rules.controlName: GenAI / LLM workload — control theme monitoring
rules.description: Observability for latency, errors, token/cost signals, and content-safety blocks; alerting on anomalous egress or jailbreak patterns (design intent).
